title: jasminonerium grandiflorum
intro: Jasminonerium grandiflorum, commonly known as the Sandalwood, is a type of evergreen tree native to India and parts of Southeast Asia, renowned for its distinctive, woody fragrance. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Sandalwood include promoting relaxation and reducing stress, as well as providing relief from anxiety and insomnia. Its bioactive constituents, such as alpha-santalol, beta-santalol, and santalol, contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and aromatherapy.
